_comment: Which numbered line of the 02-basic section produced which settings write.
WHICH log. Two log.txt files exist: the repo-root one and a stale 05:40 copy
in windows-run/. The data settles it rather than memory -- under the root
log's numbering every write matches its line's stated VALUE (line 15 says 600
and the bytes say 0x0258; line 16 says 1250 and the bytes say 0x04e2), and
line 9 is marked NOT PRESENT there, which is exactly the line that produced
no write. The stale copy asks for 400/800/3200 on those same lines and does
not fit. the owner used the root log.
Order note: writes 28 and 29 are lines 18b and 18c, which appear BEFORE the
LOD lines in the log but were applied after them. Harmless -- the map is
keyed by write index and each entry names its own line, and the diffs are
taken between consecutive writes in capture order either way. The identity
is not in doubt: 18b is the only line that sets CPI 1 X to 1000, and record
7 polling + 1 angle + 1 LED + 4 level-count + 4 CPI value + 11 LOD + 2 X/Y
= 30, which is exactly the number of writes in the capture.

no_write_lines.9: ripple control -- marked NOT PRESENT on the page. No APPLY, no write.
no_write_lines.18a: ticking X/Y Settings is a UI mode change; the log predicted NO APPLY and none happened.
no_write_lines.18d: CPI 4 -> 800 -- not performed. See the gap in working-memory.md: the stage-4 flag is untested.
no_write_lines.30: LOD 12th slot -- the dropdown has 11 options, so there was nothing to select.
no_write_lines.34: SKIPPED in the log, moved to section 06.
